summary: First part of the validate-modules error code table, covering deprecation codes like ansible-deprecated-module, collection-deprecated-version, deprecated-date and ansible-module-not-initialized.
questions: What does the validate-modules error deprecated-date mean?

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (deprecation)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ansible-deprecated-module` / `collection-deprecated-module`: module should already be removed in this version
- `ansible-deprecated-version` / `collection-deprecated-version`: a deprecated feature is past its removal version
- `ansible-module-not-initialized`: AnsibleModule wasn't initialized
- `deprecated-date`: `removed_at_date` is in the past
